vnet-peering-prefer-regional.title: Regional peering costs less than global peering
vnet-peering-prefer-regional.body: This estimate has cross-region (global) peering traffic. Microsoft advises using regional peering instead of global peering when workloads can be placed in the same Azure region, because regional peering costs less.

citation.quote: Implement regional VNet peering instead of global peering when workloads can be colocated in the same Azure region. Regional peering costs less than global peering.
